systems.country_label: portail des services publics du Niger (service-public.ne)
systems.owner: Agence Nationale pour la Société de l'Information (ANSI) with the Haut-Commissariat à la Modernisation de l'Etat; financed by France through the AFD
systems.tiers: National portal of administrative procedures, launched 2021-01-28; its home page lists obtaining an extract of the criminal record (casier judiciaire) among the procedures

note: A general government procedures portal, not a police system; the criminal record extract is listed as a procedure and nothing is said of reports or cases recorded at a station.
